title: Enrique 'Felipe Lobos' Murciano Says He Got At Least Three Jobs Since Power Because Of Courtney Kemp
htmlContent:
Earlier this week, Enrique Murciano, who played 'Felipe Lobos' in the original Power was a guest on the Crew Has It with Michael Rainey Jr. and Gianni Paolo.

During the episode, Murciano talked about how he would forget his lines and his makeup artist Anita helping him with his lines.

"Anita was a big part of my job of what I did with Lobos because every morning she is who I talked to. I get to work sometimes I don't know my lines. Okay, I'm never getting hired again, but I'm sitting in the make up chair with Anita, 'My little coconut' does that sound good? Anita helped me do Lobos," said Murciano.

"We always used to play around with the idea of a prequel of Lobos called 'Poder,' [which is Power in Spanish], too because she [Courtney Kemp] was smart. While I was on season one already playing your show [Ghost] she was planning an empire, I was like do you want coffee. She like that's cool I'm writing an empire... It's Courtney's world I just live in it. I love her too and not just on our show she's helped me get at least three jobs because of Courtney after working with her because people had called her and said what do you think about Enrique? She's like hire him I love him."

Since his departure from the Power Universe, Murciano has been featured on shows such as Bloodline, Tell Me Your Secrets, The Black List, Briarpatch, and Pancic to name a few.
